{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Indonesia|Cuisine of Indonesia]]

'''Nastar''', or '''tananas''', are [[Cookbook:pineapple|pineapple]] jam-filled cookies. These are popular treats for Eid ul-Fitr and Christmas celebrations in Indonesia.

==Ingredients==

=== Jam ===
* 2 [[Cookbook:Pineapple|pineapples]]
* 300 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] (1⅓ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]]/11 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]] 
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]] stick
===Cookie===
* 500 g (2 cups/1.1 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]]) [[Cookbook:Margarine|margarine]]
* 500 g (3½ cups/1.1 lb) [[Cookbook:All-purpose flour|all-purpose flour]]
* 6 [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]] yolks
* 1 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] (2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]]) [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 5 <nowiki/>[[Cookbook:Gram|g]] [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]] powder
* 1 oz (⅓ cup/30 g) [[Cookbook:Grating|grated]] Gouda or [[Cookbook:Cheddar Cheese|Cheddar]] [[Cookbook:Cheese|cheese]]
* 2 beaten egg yolks, for [[Cookbook:Brush|brushing]] the top of the cookies
* ½ oz (15 g) [[Cookbook:Raisin|raisins]] for garnish

==Procedure==
===Jam===
# Peel pineapple, wash, and blend into a [[Cookbook:Purée|purée]].
# Put pineapple purée in a pan, add sugar and cinnamon, and stir over medium heat until thick.
# If the jam still tastes sour, add more sugar to taste.
# Let cool until thick enough to roll into small marbles.

===Dough===
# [[Cookbook:Beating|Beat]] the 6 egg yolks with margarine and sugar.
# Mix in the grated cheese.
# Add flour and vanilla little by little to make a [[Cookbook:Dough|dough]].

===Assembly===
# Pinch off pieces of dough, and roll into balls a little smaller than golf balls.
# Flatten each piece of dough slightly, and place a pineapple jam marble on the cookie. Fold the dough around the jam enclose it, and pinch to seal the cookie. Roll it between your hands until round again.
# Place the cookies on a [[Cookbook:Parchment Paper|parchment]]-lined [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking sheet]], flattening them very slightly.
# Halve raisins, then put on top of the cookies.
# [[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] the cookies with beaten egg yolk.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] for 30 minutes or until golden yellow and cooked through.
